volunteerExperiences.description: Helped carry out an effort to contact and recruit volunteers for the purpose of collecting food. Dropped off bags to residences around the city on Saturday and asked residences to fill bags with whatever non-perishable food items they could. Then returned on Monday (MLK Jr. day) to collect filled bags. Bags were taken to the local food bank. Our town alone brought in over 3,000 pounds of food.
